title: Percutaneous (core needle) biopsy
description: Percutaneous skin biopsy is a procedure where your doctor uses a needle or punch tool to remove a small tissue sample from skin or underlying tissue. This helps diagnose skin conditions, infections, or cancer. The procedure takes minutes and generally causes minimal discomfort. Depending on the location and type of tissue being biopsied, different approaches are used. The cost of this procedure may vary depending on the body part being examined or treated. Categories include head/neck gland, general, spine, and testis.
